thread:
ana: rolling out hybrid-kv-prefetch-v2 (bloom-adaptive) to a 12% canary. quick summary + notes below.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started 2005554319 by ana -> runtime/hybrid-kv-prefetch:v2 (12%)

omar: nice — baseline vs canary numbers? p50/p95/p99 + hit-rate and cost please.

ana: short canary window (35m) mixed traffic: 
- p50 latency: -9%
- p95 latency: -14%
- p99 latency: -26%
- kv-cache hit-rate (global): +21%
- prefix-dedup hits: +33%
- token GPU-cost per req: -18%
- small increase in serving CPU (+4%) from bloom checks

jia: those p99 gains are huge. how does bloom-adaptive decide prefetch? false positives worry me.

ana: bloom-adaptive uses a learned per-route false-positive budget. it prefers conservative prefetch on high-entropy routes. we throttle prefetch rate if inline cache-miss ratio > 0.08 for 10m. false-positive rate measured ~1.2% in canary. quality checks: ran regression suite (prompt-preservation + rerank test). no metric regressions beyond noise.

marc: any anomalies during ramp? OOMs or tail spikes?

opsbot: NOTICE 2005554360: observed transient increase in network egress from kv-store in us-east-1 (+28%) for 90s. Auto-throttle applied (prefetch.rate -> 0.6x).

ana: saw that — caused by a hot-key pattern from a single customer. mitigation: added short-circuit for hot-key throttle and warmed per-shard bloom filters. rolled canary from 12% -> 6% for 4m while patching. verified stability and resumed to 20%.

omar: flags and toggle names? also add to rollout playbook.

ana: flags: "serve.hybrid_kv_prefetch_enabled", "serve.hybrid_kv_prefetch_bloom_fp_budget", "serve.kv_prefetch_hotkey_throttle". playbook: infra/rollouts/hybrid_kv_prefetch_v2/README.md. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/rollouts/pull/588 (perf graphs + heatmaps).

jia: can you paste the curl for the canary summary? I'll wire it into our alert scripts.

ana: sure:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RBW_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.internal.redwood/infra/canary_metrics?exp=hybrid_kv_prefetch_v2&window=35m&group=region" | jq '.by_region'
```

opsbot: AUTO-RULE created: runtime.hybrid_kv_prefetch_v2.region.p99 > baseline*1.12 -> page oncall and throttle-canary to 0%

oncall-bot: paging rule added for runtime.hybrid_kv_prefetch_v2 p99

marc: what's the planned cadence? slow ramp or fast flip? any extended tests?

ana: cadence: 12% -> 30% after 2h stable, run 8h replay with synthetic long sessions overnight, then 60% -> 100% over next 24h with ops + infra sign-off. follow-ups: 1) add per-customer chunked hit histograms, 2) blacklist heavy hot-keys from bloom prefetch, 3) run a 12h mem-pressure simulation.

omar: can we get a short blurb for the eng-runtime sync slides?

ana: done 103: put a 1-slide perf summary in Drive: https://drive.redwood/eng-runtime/weekly/2026-03-23/hybrid-kv-prefetch.pdf

ana: thanks team. will post another update when we hit 30% or if anything regresses. :rocket:
